scope: Guarded extension reader/preservation development stage; not production v3 admission/export

checks.independent_review: P2 final-read invalidation race fixed; re-review found no remaining concrete blocker

coverage.actual_wasm: Full strict descriptor validation, identity merge/seal/open, public encrypted-v3 import, actual preflight before prepare/confirm/edit, existing102-vector reader parity in full npm suite.
coverage.adapter_tests: In-memory storage dictionary; atomic-set failure and post-real-preflight refusal injected explicitly. Previews detached from exact prepared encrypted bytes; cancel/expiry/lock/same-revision ciphertext change, source/collection conflicts and combined count/section limits. Final-read invalidation regressions fail before the fix and pass after, including cancel-only calls with unchanged custody epoch.
coverage.loaded_chrome: Actual Chrome storage.local read/set and disk restart, root unlock required; exact encrypted bytes preserved; actual QUOTA_BYTES failure left no identity/feed record; two real UI pages exercise stale review and expected-revision refusal. Controlled real REVOKE_ORIGIN invalidation during each final paused Chrome read blocks review/edit/confirm.
coverage.ui: Incoming/preserved metadata, all source and collection fields as inert text, no anchors/fetch/activation, stale asynchronous read cannot repopulate after invalidation.

safeguards.browser_transformation: One in-memory esbuild import-gate override in private development-only package; default guarded copy also tested.
safeguards.controlled_browser_instrumentation: Test-only pause of real storage.get; no changed storage values or production source. Real existing revocation handler performs epoch invalidation/cancel.

remaining_limits: Development positive acceptance does not enable production v3 import/export or assert completion of every consumer rollout.

Chrome storage.local has no independent cross-context CAS. All supported mutations remain inside the existing single service-worker custody FIFO, plus exact encrypted-snapshot/revision fencing. Future external writers would require a new serialization/CAS design.
Loaded browser proved quota rejection, not process termination during a storage.set or disk corruption/power-loss recovery.
Timer expiry and same-revision ciphertext substitution are deterministic adapter tests; two-page stale review/form, cancellation, quota failure and full restart are actual browser tests.
No external feed transport/login/activation, personal browser profile, extension installation into an existing browser profile, physical device, custody/authority change or production writer used.
browser_qualification: Actual disposable Chrome profiles and private guarded/qualified development packages; only one in-memory import-gate override, never a production capability. Production source bytes remained unchanged and profiles were removed.
